summary: Slow, scaling tank who pokes with his E, threatens a big stun with a charged Q, and gains permanent max HP from kills. He wants to farm safely and become unkillable; punish him early, dodge the charged Q, and use %HP or true damage once he's big.
threats: Q (Decimating Smash) charges in a long rectangle. Fully charged, it knocks up and stuns; walk out the side, not straight back.
E (Roar of the Slayer) slows and shreds armor. If it hits a minion, the minion is knocked back through you.
W (Soul Furnace) shields him, then can be recast to explode for %max HP magic damage. Back off when the shield is up.
Passive (Glory in Death): when he dies he revives briefly with fast autos. Walk away from the zombie instead of standing on your kill.
R (Unstoppable Onslaught) at 5: a long charge that can't be stopped by CC and knocks up on impact. Ping it; he can use it to roam or engage.

matchups.why: Vayne out-ranges Sion and her W (Silver Bolts) true %HP damage gets stronger the more max HP he stacks. Tumble steps out of his charged Q, and he has no gap closer before level 5 to stop her kiting.
trading: Auto him every time he walks up to last-hit, then step back before his E can hit you.
When he starts charging Q, Tumble (Q) sideways out of the rectangle and auto him during the wind-up.
Land three-hit Silver Bolts procs, then back off before his W shield explodes on you.
Save Condemn (E) for his R charge or to push him off you when he walks into melee range.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 are yours: poke him with autos every time he farms. He can only trade back with E, so sidestep it and keep hitting.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R can engage from long range. Keep Tumble up when he disappears, and walk away from his zombie passive after you kill him.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates. He wants to farm safely and scale; make every last-hit cost him HP.
matchups.jungle: He is slow and has no escape before R. Call your jungler when his Q and E are on cooldown.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. On-hit attack speed and crit; Blade of the Ruined King is strong against his HP stacking.
matchups.remember: Tumble the Q, shred the HP.

matchups.why: Fiora's vitals deal true %max HP damage, so Sion's HP stacking makes her stronger. Riposte parries his charged Q and stuns him back, turning his main engage into her trade window.
trading: Lunge (Q) onto a vital when he walks up, then step back before he can hit you with E.
Hold W (Riposte) for his fully charged Q; parrying it stuns him and wins the trade.
If he doesn't charge Q, walk out of the rectangle's side instead of wasting Riposte.
Trade after his W shield pops or expires so your vitals damage goes into his HP.
matchups.early: Short Q-into-vital trades win levels 1–3. Don't stay in melee range when he has W up; the explosion hurts.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R hits four vitals and its heal zone wins the fight. Use it after he's used Q, and walk away from his zombie.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates, then split-push once you're ahead. He can't duel you in a side lane later.
matchups.jungle: He's easy to gank before 5 with no escape. Ping when his Q is down so the stun can't stop your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Bruiser items; Blade of the Ruined King for his HP.
matchups.remember: Parry the charge, hit the vitals.

matchups.why: Gwen's Q and passive deal %max HP magic damage, so the bigger Sion gets the harder she hits him. Her W (Hallowed Mist) blocks his poke from outside, and he struggles to land the charged Q on her E dash.
trading: Stack Q with autos on him, then land the centre of the final snip for true damage.
Step into W (Hallowed Mist) when he charges Q or throws E so he can't target you from outside.
E (Skip 'n Slash) sideways out of his charged Q rather than backwards along it.
Back off when his W shield is up and wait for it to pop before your full combo.
matchups.early: Take short Q trades once you have stacks. Level 1–2 is even, so don't take long fights into his E armor shred.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R adds poke and slows. Fight after his Q is down, and step out of the zombie's range after you kill him.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade when he walks up to farm. You scale better against tanks than he does against you.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape before R. Gank when his Q is on cooldown so he can't stun your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. AP bruiser items with %HP damage; magic pen helps against his MR.
matchups.remember: Mist the poke, snip the HP.

matchups.why: Darius wins extended melee fights, and Sion is a slow, immobile tank who has to stand near him to farm. Hemorrhage stacks and the outer edge of Q out-damage Sion's shield, and Darius can pull him back out of a charged Q.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him when he starts charging Q; the pull cancels the charge and drags him into your Q.
Hit him with the outer edge of Q (Decimate) for bonus damage and healing.
Stack Hemorrhage with autos and W, but back off before his W shield explodes on you.
Walk out of his E slow before he can follow up with a charged Q.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 favour you. Trade every time he walks up to farm; he can't out-trade Hemorrhage stacks.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R executes and resets on kill. Watch for his zombie after you kill him and walk away from it.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade often, then freeze once you're ahead so he has to walk up to you to farm.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape before R. Gank once his Q is down so he can't stun your jungler.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Black Cleaver and bruiser items; armor boots.
matchups.remember: Pull him in, out-trade the tank.

matchups.why: Both tanks farm and scale, and neither can kill the other alone early. Malphite's armor and passive shield absorb Sion's physical poke, while Sion out-scales in raw HP. The lane is decided by roams and team-fight ults.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm, then walk away with the speed you stole.
Keep Granite Shield up before he throws E; it soaks his poke.
E (Ground Slam) when he's in melee range to slow his attack speed and cut his trade.
Walk out of the side of his charged Q rather than straight back.
matchups.early: Farm safely and Q poke. Neither of you wins much damage early, so don't take long trades into his W explosion.
matchups.spike: At 5 both R's are long-range engages. Roam with yours when he's shoved; ping his R when he leaves lane.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and roam with R once it's up. He's slow to follow if you crash the wave first.
matchups.jungle: Your R sets up ganks. Call when his Q is on cooldown so he can't stun back.
matchups.build: Grasp. Plated Steelcaps and armor; Sunfire Aegis for wave clear.

matchups.why: Sion's E poke and charged Q punish Nasus every time he walks up to stack Q, and his shield absorbs Nasus's early damage. Nasus out-scales once he has stacks, but he has to survive a lane where Sion keeps him off the wave.
trading: W (Wither) him when he walks up so his slow trade can't follow you back to tower.
Stack Q on minions only when his E is on cooldown so he can't poke you as you farm.
Walk out of the side of his charged Q; never stand still while he's charging it.
E (Spirit Fire) the wave from range to keep stacking without walking into his poke.
matchups.early: Give up contested creeps and farm under tower. Your goal is stacks and items, not trades.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives HP and resists so you can survive his engage, but don't start fights with it.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower and stack Q on cannon minions. He can't dive you early.
matchups.jungle: Ask for a gank when his Q is down and he's overextended; he has no escape before R.
matchups.build: Grasp. Armor boots early; Black Cleaver later for his HP.
